name: Chantilly Chamber

name: Double Fold

name: Clotted Reverie

name: Crème Diplomate

name: Satin Custard

name: Softline
description: A tall smartphone with a large rounded contact tile, slim status strip and soft incoming bubbles.

name: Crème Connect
description: A wide smartphone with a twin-photo contact banner, contrasting side bezels and a rounded conversation panel.

name: Dollop

name: Petite Rosette

name: Creamdrop

name: Two Spoonfuls
